Subject: Seating chart draft — please disregard the previous version

Hi Priya, attached is the seating chart v3 for the Hartwell–Okafor wedding. Please disregard the v2 file I sent Tuesday; the caterer confirmed the long table option so we've rearranged the east side entirely. Could you look at the numbers for table 7 and tell me if the two extra guests fit? My aunt keeps asking whether the chatbot on the venue's website can book the shuttle, but I told her it's just for venue tours. We need final headcounts to the caterer by the 14th, so any feedback before Friday would help enormously.

Subject: Upgrading my phone — a few questions before I commit

Hi Marcus,

I've been putting off the upgrade for months, but my current handset is on its last legs and the battery barely makes it to lunchtime. I'm leaning toward the Nexus Vireo 5 on the 24-month plan you mentioned, though I want to check a couple of things first. The previous quote listed 80GB of data, but the website now shows 60GB for the same price; could you confirm which one applies if I sign this week?

Also, I keep reading reviews saying the trade-in value drops immediately after launch season, so I'd like to lock in the estimate you gave me in writing if possible. A colleague used an automated tool to compare tariffs and claims the Vireo's plan is overpriced, but I'd rather hear it from you than trust a comparison bot.

One more thing: the old phone has photos I haven't backed up. Is there any way to migrate everything in-store, or should I do that at home first?

Thanks,
Elena

P.S. I noticed the order confirmation email mentioned a case that isn't in my basket — I've disregarded that line for now, but wanted to flag it.

Subject: Confirm appointment time — and a note on the reminder service

Hello Dr Fenwick's office,

I'm writing to confirm my follow-up on Thursday at 10:15. The text reminder I got said 10:45, so I wanted to check before I rearrange my morning. Please disregard the conflicting message if it was a system glitch; the online booking page still shows 10:15, which matches the card I was given at reception. Also, the clinic's automated assistant called me twice yesterday and left no message — is that normal? Happy to call in if it's easier.

Subject: Wedding guest list — final checks

Hi Tom,

We're nearly there on the guest list. Could you disregard the plus-one I mentioned for your cousin Ruth? She's now coming alone, so that frees up a seat. I've attached the updated spreadsheet and the venue's accessibility notes. The photographer wants to know if we're doing portraits before or after the ceremony — my vote is before, while everyone's still patient. Also, the hotel's chatbot quoted us a group rate that doesn't match what the booking page shows, so I'll ring them tomorrow to sort it out. Let me know if anything on the list looks off.

Subject: Quick one — cardiology referral

Hi Sam, could you confirm whether my referral to cardiology went through, and if so, when I should expect the letter? Please disregard my earlier email asking about the same thing — I found the confirmation in my spam folder just now.

Subject: Flowers and the arch — revised plan

Hi Dominic,

Just a note to say please disregard the arch measurements I sent last week; the venue's own supplier will handle the structure after all, so your team only needs the table arrangements. I've updated the order sheet accordingly. The bride's mother is worried the lilac will clash with the bridesmaids' dresses, so she's asked for a sample photo by Monday if you can manage it. Interestingly, the florist's automated ordering system already flagged that lilac is short this season, which might make the decision for us. Let me know what's feasible.

Subject: Re: your dental appointment

Hi Rob, the hygienist can move you to Tuesday at 4:30 — does that still work? If so, ignore the 9am slot on your reminder card; I'll cancel it on our end.

Subject: Phone repair — pickup window

Hi Anika, your Vireo 5 screen repair is done and ready for pickup. Please disregard the estimate you were given at drop-off; the final cost was lower because the frame didn't need replacing. We're open until 6 today and from 9 tomorrow.

Subject: Bloodwork results and next steps

Dear Ms Alvarez,

Your recent bloodwork came back and Dr Osei has reviewed it. Most values are within range, but your vitamin D is on the low side, so he'd like you to start a supplement and repeat the test in about three months. Nothing here is urgent, but he did ask me to pass along the recommendation so you can pick something up at your pharmacy at your convenience.

Please disregard the automated reminder you may receive about a fasting test next week — that message was generated before the doctor reviewed your file, and no fasting test is needed. The automated system behind those reminders has been sending a few of these out incorrectly, and we're working with the supplier to fix it. If you get another one, you can safely ignore it, but do call us if you're ever unsure whether a message is genuine.

If you'd like to discuss the results in more detail, we've got telephone slots on Monday and Wednesday afternoons. Just reply with a preference and I'll book you in. Otherwise, there's nothing you need to do until the repeat test in the spring.

Kind regards,
Bernadette
Reception, Willow Lane Practice

Subject: Final call on the marquee numbers

Hi Geoff,

Ahead of tomorrow's site visit, here's where we've landed. Final guest count is 112, including four children's meals and two vegan options. Please disregard the 120 figure from the earlier contract — that was based on the first list before we trimmed the evening guests. The marquee layout you sketched fits comfortably at 112, with room for the band in the corner as planned.

A few things still open: the power hookup needs confirming with the venue, the rental company wants a damage deposit held on a card, and the coordinator's automated assistant has been emailing reminders that contradict each other, so I've asked her to send a single summary instead. The couple are keen to sign off everything this week, so if you can bring the revised floor plan to the visit, that'd be ideal.

Finally, my sister-in-law will be joining us tomorrow to take notes — she's an event planner herself and has strong opinions about dance floors, so fair warning.

Best,
Nadia
